# IO layer rules

- Vendor libraries (`com.ctre`, `yams`, `com.pathplanner`, `org.photonvision`)
  may be imported only in files under an `io/` folder. Nowhere else.
- An IO interface has an `@AutoLog` inputs class and an empty default body on
  every method, so `new XIO() {}` is the replay implementation.
- Every mechanism needs a working sim IO. Step physics once per `updateInputs`
  using the loop period, never a wall clock.
- Real-hardware IO (`*TalonFX`, `*Yams`) must be marked untested until it has run
  on a robot. Placeholders (CAN ids, gains) are marked as placeholders.
- Do not add inputs or methods to an IO interface without updating every
  implementation and the mechanism card in `docs/robot/`.
